# Linkedin Jobs Scraper

The Apify actor [`worldunboxer/rapid-linkedin-scraper`](https://apify.com/worldunboxer/rapid-linkedin-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **1.2.161** (module version **1.4.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

Scrape LinkedIn jobs with powerful search and advanced filters using keywords, search URLs and locations.🔥$0.10/1K jobs. Extract job listing, full job details, and company details directly from LinkedIn job search results.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Job result $0.0001, Job data enrichment $0.00025, Actor Start $0.00005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/worldunboxer/rapid-linkedin-scraper) for current prices.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Telo.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

Combined with 'Company Names': the companies from both lists are searched. A company's ID is the number after 'f_C=' in the address of a LinkedIn jobs search filtered by that company. |
